is_seam_isolated.instructions: Judge the syntax unit against the criteria.

criteria.true: The code keeps vendor SDK details (types, error classes, client construction) inside the adapter boundary; nothing vendor-specific escapes to callers.
criteria.false: Vendor SDK details leak: vendor types appear in exported signatures, vendor error classes escape, or callers must know the vendor to use this code.

will_error_lose_cause.instructions: Judge the syntax unit against the criteria.

criteria.true: Error handling loses information: a caught error is swallowed, rethrown without its cause, or replaced by a message that drops the original failure detail.
criteria.false: Error handling preserves information: causes are chained, messages include the original failure detail, and nothing is swallowed silently.
